summary: Frontend-only verification of new Term-Loan-vs-Leasing Finance Deep Dive. 8/9 spec checks pass. Flow (load-demo → 4× calc-next-btn) reaches results with res-net-benefit ₹2,82,820, no NaN/Infinity anywhere. finance-structure toggle works; explainer copy switches correctly ('Term Loan: you own the plant from day one…' vs 'Operating Lease: EFL owns…'). LOAN default: emi-amount ₹4,49,293/month; finance-method Reducing↔Flat works; on Flat, red pill 'Effective rate ≈ 14.4%' vs quoted 8.5% (~1.69× — cleanly higher ✅) and flat-slider becomes visible. Fee breakdown rows all render with rupee values: Project cost ₹3,28,00,000, Down payment (20% margin) ₹65,60,000, Loan amount ₹2,62,40,000, Processing fee (1%) ₹2,62,400, GST on processing fee (18%) ₹47,232, Insurance (0.35%) ₹1,14,800, Total upfront ₹69,84,432. LEASE mode: rental-amount ₹5,06,062/month, sub-line ₹4,28,866 + ₹77,196 GST; lease-slider visible; lease summary shows Rental incl GST ₹5,06,062, Rental ex GST ₹4,28,866, GST/month ₹77,196, Total rentals ₹4.25 Cr, Rental per unit ₹4.39/kWh, Ownership transfers Sept 2033. Comparison table renders all 7 rows (Ownership, Monthly payment, Balance sheet, Depreciation, GST, Income-tax benefit, Pre-closure) with distinct Term Loan and Operating Lease columns. Monthly schedule (loan) = 84 rows, last row Sept 33 balance ₹0 ✅. Sanity: 5,06,062 × 84 ≈ ₹4.25 Cr (matches Total rentals) — internally consistent. Regression: /financing and /epc load; Tariff History card still renders below finance (10-yr CAGR 4.0% for Haryana).

ui_bugs.issue: Lease tenure is bound to the loan's tenureYears (user slider = 7yr → 84 months) instead of the EFL Mahesh proposal's 5-year (60-month) operating lease. Consequence: monthly-schedule shows 84 lease rows instead of the 60 the review spec expects; rental amount ₹5,06,062 (not ₹1,12,033 from the proposal) because the same principal is amortised over 84 months at 9.5% instead of the proposal's structure. Rental per unit, ownership transfer date, and total rentals are all internally consistent but the underlying tenure is wrong per spec.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Calculator.jsx line 652 (FinanceDeepDive → calculateLease call), stop reusing the loan's tenureYears. Introduce a lease-specific tenure (default 5 years / 60 months per the EFL Mahesh proposal, or make it its own state/slider). Update dependent lease.months labels, the yearly schedule (line ~832) and 'for X rentals' copy accordingly. Verify the sample scenario reproduces the proposal's ₹1,12,033/month rental figure that engine.js already computes correctly when called with tenureYears=5.
Optional enhancement: expose a lease-tenure slider (e.g., 3–7yr) alongside lease-slider so users can compare fairly.
critical_code_review_comments: Calculator.jsx L652: calculateLease({ ..., tenureYears, ... }) — this ties lease term to loan term. Per EFL proposal these are independent products (loan 7y typical, lease 5y typical). Bug per spec.
engine.js calculateLease default tenureYears=5 is correct; the caller overrides it. Fix at the call site, not in the engine.
Lease schedule sanity math (rental × months = total rentals incl GST) is correct, so no computation bug — only wrong input plumbing.
No NaN/Infinity/undefined observed anywhere in results, fee breakdown, comparison table, or 84-row monthly schedules — number formatting is solid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Finance Deep Dive testids all present and working: finance-structure, emi-amount, rental-amount, lease-slider, finance-method, flat-slider, fee-slider, toggle-schedule, toggle-monthly, monthly-schedule. Loan flow is production-ready (84 rows, closes at ₹0). ONLY open bug: lease tenure is coupled to loan tenureYears in Calculator.jsx L652 — should default to 5yr (60 months) per EFL Mahesh proposal so monthly-schedule shows 60 rows and rental matches proposal's ₹1,12,033. Everything else passes; regression pages /financing, /epc and Tariff History card all fine.
rca of the issue: Root cause: FinanceDeepDive component (Calculator.jsx L637-L653) receives a single tenureYears prop (the user's loan tenure slider) and forwards it to both calculateFinancingPackage (loan) AND calculateLease. calculateLease's own default of 5 years is thus overridden. Reproduction: /calculator → load-demo (tenure defaults to 7y) → 4× Continue → scroll to Financing full breakdown → toggle finance-structure to Leasing → 'for 84 rentals' and 84-row schedule appear. Mitigation: decouple leaseTenureYears (const 5 or its own state) from tenureYears in the calculateLease call and in all display labels (lease.months usages at L673, L694, L712, L755, L832-839, L849, L870, L885).
